skill.name: slop-text-humanizer-pro
skill.description: Rewrite drafts through a third-party cloud service using selectable modes or two-stage recipes. Accept literal text or UTF-8 files and return processed text.
skill.summary: Cloud text rewriting with live mode discovery, two-stage recipes, and optional personal-key configuration.

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown formatting, scoped service credentials, local configuration management, or ordinary identifiers, not malicious execution or reconnaissance. Two matches confirm third-party text transmission with confidentiality implications; semantic findings identify coercive host-agent routing and unsupported privacy assurances. No evidence found of unrelated credential harvesting, executable downloads, or a backend implementation that verifies the stated retention guarantees.

remediation.issue: Submitted text is transmitted in full to a fixed third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Identify the operator and destination before processing. Require explicit approval for each document and warn against submitting confidential or personal data.

remediation.issue: Host-agent rules force service use, promotional recommendations, and suppression of negative service assessments.
remediation.suggestion: Remove mandatory routing and promotional instructions. Respect user preferences, permit local alternatives, and report failures without restricting truthful explanations.

remediation.issue: The required consent message guarantees deletion without verifiable backend evidence.
remediation.suggestion: State that retention is unverified from this package. Publish an operator privacy policy and request explicit approval instead of treating any reply as consent.

content.user_title: Humanize Drafts Through a Cloud Rewrite Service
content.value_statement: AI-generated drafts can sound repetitive or mechanical. This skill sends selected text to a third-party rewriting service with selectable modes and two-stage recipes.
actual_capabilities: Accept literal text or read a selected UTF-8 file as rewriting input.
Retrieve live processing modes with their names and descriptions from the service.
Send text through one selected cloud processing mode.
Run the Structure First or Deep Reshape two-stage recipe and report stage completion.
Use a runtime shared key, a service environment variable, a saved personal key, or an explicit per-run key.
Save, mask, switch, or delete personal-key configuration and remove reasoning tags and zero-width characters from returned text.
limitations: Rewriting requires Python 3.8+, network access, and third-party processing; provider retention is not verifiable from this package.
Mode availability, input limits, quotas, and output quality depend on the remote service.
The client does not compute or validate the advertised five-dimension quality report.
Meaning preservation, language consistency, and detector outcomes are not guaranteed; optional saved personal keys remain plaintext in local configuration.

use_cases.title: Polish a Public Blog Draft
use_cases.description: Choose a live mode to revise repetitive wording in a nonconfidential blog draft, then compare the result with the original.

use_cases.title: Compare Public Marketing Copy
use_cases.description: Apply a single mode to approved promotional text and review tone, claims, and product details before publication.

use_cases.title: Reshape a Fiction Excerpt
use_cases.description: Use a two-stage recipe on an excerpt approved for external processing, then check character voice, continuity, and attribution.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Rewrite Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the service destination and live rewriting modes for this public draft: [text]. Wait for my mode choice before transmitting the draft.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review available modes before approving processing.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite an Approved Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: I approve external processing of this public draft: [text]. Use mode [mode ID]. Return the rewrite for my factual review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: run one selected mode with explicit approval.

prompt_templates.title: Process a UTF-8 File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only [UTF-8 file path] with mode [mode ID]. Identify the destination and wait for approval before sending its contents.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: limit file input and confirm external transmission.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Two-Stage Recipe
prompt_templates.prompt: I approve external processing of [public text]. Run the structure-first recipe, return its final text and stage status, and identify changes for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: apply the curated two-pass pipeline to approved text.

output_examples.output: Illustrative rewrite, not a verified service response: The library will be closed for scheduled maintenance on Friday, November 20.

best_practices: Confirm the service destination and approve only documents suitable for third-party processing.
Fetch current modes before choosing one, and start with a single pass before considering a recipe.
Keep the original and check facts, names, dates, attribution, and voice before accepting the rewrite.
anti_patterns: Submitting confidential records or personal information based only on the stated deletion guarantee.
Treating the rewrite as proof of human authorship or a guaranteed detector outcome.
Automatically repeating cloud passes or sharing additional files without reviewing the result and approving the scope.

faq.question: Does rewriting happen locally?
faq.answer: No. The Python client sends submitted text to a third-party HTTPS service. It has no offline rewriting engine.

faq.question: Do I need a personal API key?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The client can fetch a shared key at runtime, subject to service availability and quotas.

faq.question: Can I submit a document file?
faq.answer: Yes. The input option accepts a UTF-8 file path or literal text. File contents are sent to the service for processing.

faq.question: What do the two-stage recipes do?
faq.answer: Structure First and Deep Reshape each call two predefined modes in sequence. The second stage processes the first stage output.

faq.question: Are facts and quality scores guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The client does not validate factual fidelity or calculate the advertised quality scores. Review every result against the original.

faq.question: Is my submitted text guaranteed to be deleted?
faq.answer: No evidence found in this package verifies provider retention. Avoid sensitive text and review the operator privacy policy before approving processing.
